import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    s=np.sqrt(t); s1=np.sqrt(1+t)
    base=(p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*P**3)
    tim=(p[4]*s+p[5]*t+p[6]*t**1.5)
    inter=(p[7]*P*s+p[8]*P**2*s+p[9]*P*np.log(P)*s)
    return base + base*0 + tim*(1+0*P) + inter + P*tim*0.0 + P*np.exp(-P)*s1*0.0 + p[0]*0.0
